description: Demolition of existing outbuildings and erection of an attached two storey dwelling with associated landscaping including cycle and refuse storage to the rear and side.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All tree(s) on and adjacent to the site shown to be retained shall be protected in accordance with the Arboricultural information submitted with the Application (Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan) and follow recommendations in British Standard BS 5837: Trees in Relation to Design, Demolition and Construction - Recommendations (2012). There will be no materials stored within Construction Exclusion Zone (CEZ), and the Tree Protection Fencing (TPF) and other measures shall only be removed on completion of development. On completion of development, the applicant (their heirs or successors in title) shall submit photographic evidence of compliance with BS5837:2012. Reason: To ensure tree(s) significant in terms of their provision of local amenity are protected from construction damage, in accordance with best practice and Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development falling within Classes A, B, C, or E of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the said Order shall be carried out without the prior explicit grant of planning permission from the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To prevent overdevelopment, safeguard the private garden space, protect neighbouring privacy and amenity, and ensure site habitat space is maintained in accordance with Policies 9, 26, 28, and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Strategy (as set out in the approved Design and Access Statement).Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building (1 Danescourt Crescent) and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the new dwelling harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

All soft and hard landscaping and tree planting shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved Landscape Plan Report (Rev B) prior to the first occupation of the dwelling or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. All works shall be carried out to a reasonable standard in accordance with the relevant recommendations of British Standards (BS 3882: Specifications for Topsoil and BS 8545: Trees from Nursery to Independence in the Landscape). Any tree(s) or plants that (within a period of five years after planting) are removed, die, or (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) are damaged or defective shall be replaced as soon as is reasonably practicable with others of a similar size/species/number as originally approved, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written consent to any variation.   Reason: To ensure the provision, establishment and maintenance of a reasonable standard of landscape in accordance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the off-street car parking spaces shown on approved Drawing No. 2600, P-02 Rev C shall be provided and marked out in full. Thereafter, the parking spaces shall be permanently retained solely for the parking of vehicles associated with the occupiers of 1 Danescourt Crescent and the new dwelling, and shall not be used for any other purpose.Reason: To ensure that adequate parking provision is maintained on site and to safeguard highway safety and free flow of traffic in accordance with Policy 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and Policy T6 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the secure cycle storage facilities and refuse/recycling storage structures for both the existing host dwelling and the new dwelling as shown on Drawing No. 2600, P-05 Rev E shall be provided in full and made available for use. These facilities shall thereafter be permanently retained for their intended purposes.Reason: To promote sustainable transport modes and ensure suitable amenity provision in accordance with Policies 28 and 36 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and Policy T5 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a Statement of Conformity shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement of Conformity shall include evidence in the form of post-installation photographs confirming full details and positions of each feature for wildlife (including bird/bat boxes and hedgehog highway fence gaps) as set out in the approved Landscape Plan Report (Rev B).Reason: To certify that features for wildlife are implemented in accordance with approved details and to safeguard and enhance biodiversity in accordance with Policy 26 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and Policy G6 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the commencement of development, details of the proposed air source heat pump (ASHP) unit must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing, including: (i)  the sizing, positioning and orientation of the proposed ASHP unit; (ii) product specifications and an estimate of the heating and/or cooling energy the ASHP would provide to the development and the electricity required for this purpose; (iii)  the expected heat source temperature and the heat distribution system temperature; (vi) if necessary, revised calculations demonstrating the CO2 savings expected to be achieved. Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement for Planning prepared by Energy Report Limited and dated 25 March 2026 together with the approved air source heat pump (ASHP) details. Prior to first occupation,' 'as-built' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.  Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The surface water drainage system shall be constructed and carried out in strict accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment & Surface Water Philosophy (WtFR Ltd, Ref: 2026_03_Q04, dated 22 March 2026), incorporating permeable paving, water butts, a 4m3 attenuation storage tank, and a Hydrobrake flow control device restricted to a maximum discharge rate of 1 l/s. All approved measures shall be fully operational prior to first occupation.Reason: To ensure surface water runoff is managed sustainably, does not increase flood risk, and complies with Policy 32 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and Policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021.

Prior to the first occupation of the dwelling hereby permitted, written verification and photographic evidence confirming that the approved SuDS and surface water drainage measures have been implemented in full accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment & Surface Water Philosophy (WtFR Ltd, dated 22 March 2026) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The system shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained in accordance with the maintenance schedule set out in the approved report.Reason: To verify that the drainage system has been correctly installed and will be maintained for the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy 32 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018 and Policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021.

The rating level of the noise determined by the cumulative sound emissions of the plant hereby permitted shall be at least 5dBA lower than the existing background noise level during any normal mode of operation. The noise levels shall be measured or predicted 1m externally to any window of a habitable room at the nearest residential facade. Measurements and assessment shall be made according to British Standard 4142:201.Reason: To comply with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
